G4300.def:
προ-κυρόω, -ῶ 
to establish or confirm beforehand: Galates 3:17.†

G4301.def:
προ-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX: Wis.17:11 א2, Wis.17:17 א2B * ;] 
__1. to take beforehand: with accusative, 1 Corinthiens 11:21 (but see infr.). 
__2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), Marc 14:8. 
__3. to overtake, surprise: pass., Galates 6:1 (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).†

G4302.def:
προ-λέγω 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 41:26 (נָגַד hi.) * ;] 
__1. to tell or say before­hand: 2 Corinthiens 13:2, Galates 5:21, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:4 (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.). 
__2. to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).†

G4303.def:
προ-μαρτύρομαι 
to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): 1 Pierre 1:11 (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).†

G4304.def: to practise beforehand : with infinitive, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4305.def:
προ-μεριμνάω, -ῶ 
to be anxious beforehand: Marc 13:11.†

G4306.def:
προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι, 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6:7, al. ;] 
__1. to foresee. 
__2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Romains 12:17 (-ούμενοι), 2 Corinthiens 8:21 (-οῦμεν). 
__3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1 Timothée 5:8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†

G4307.def:
πρόνοια, -ας, ἡ
(πρόνοος, careful) [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) Wis.14:3 17:2, 4Mac.6:1-35 * ;] 
foresight, forethought: Actes 24:3; π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: Romains 13:14.†

G4308.def:
προ-οράω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Psaumes 16:8) (שָׁוָה pi.), I Esther 5:63 A * ;] 
to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, Actes 21:29. Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, Actes 2:25 (LXX).†

G4309.def:
προ-ορίζω 
to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, Romains 8:30; id. and inf., Actes 4:28; id. before εἰς, 1 Corinthiens 2:7, Éphésiens 1:5; with dupl. accusative, Romains 8:26; pass., Éphésiens 1:11.†

G4310.def: to suffer first or beforehand , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: to be ill-treated before , ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4311.def:
προ-πέμπω 
[in LXX: I Esther 4:47, Jdth.10:15, Wis.19:2, 1Ma.12:4, 2Ma.6:23 * ;] 
__1. to send before, send forth. 
__2. to set forward on a journey, escort: with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 16:11, Tite 3:13, 3Jn.6; before εἰς, Actes 20:38; οὗ, 1 Corinthiens 16:6; ἕως, Actes 21:5; pass., Actes 15:3, Romains 15:24, 2 Corinthiens 1:16.†

G4312.def:
προπετής, -ές
(προπίπτω), [in LXX: Proverbes 10:14 (אֱוִיל) Proverbes 13:3 (פָּשַׂק) Sir.9:18 * ;] 
falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, precipitate, rash, reck­less: of persons, 2 Timothée 3:4; of things, Actes 19:36.†

G4313.def:
προ-πορεύω 
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ, also for עָבַר, etc. ;] 
to make to go before. Pass. and mid., to go before: Luc 1:76, Actes 7:40" (LXX) ,†

G4316.def:
προσ-αγορεύω 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 23:6 (7) (דָּרַשׁ), ?Esther 10:11 (יָדָה hith.), Wis.14:22, 1Ma.14:40, 2Ma.1:36 2Mac 4:7 2Mac 10:9 2Mac 14:37 * ;] 
to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style: with dupl. accusative, pass., Hébreux 5:10.†

G4317.def:
προσ-άγω 
[in LXX chiefly for = קָרַב hi., also for נָגַשׁ etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to bring or lead: with accusative and dative, Actes 16:20; metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, 1 Pierre 3:18; before ὧδε, Luc 9:41; pass., with dative, Matthieu 18:24 (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, to summon: Actes 12:6 (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R). 
__2. Intrans., to draw near, approach (Josué 3:9, Jérémie 26:3 (Jérémie 46:3), al.): with dative, Actes 27:27 (WH, προσαχεῖν).†

G4318.def:
προσ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(προσάγω), 
__1. a bringing to. 
__2. approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): Romains 5:2, Éphésiens 2:18 3:12 (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).†

G4319.def:
προσ-αιτέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Job 27:14 * ;] 
__1. to ask besides. 
__2. to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms: Jean 9:8.†

G4320.def:
προσ-ανα-βαίνω 
[in LXX: Exode 19:23, al. (עָלָה) ;] 
__1. to go up besides. 
__2. to go up higher: Luc 14:10.†

G4321.def:
προσ-αναλίσκω 
to spend besides: Luc 8:43 (WH, R, mg., om.).†

G4322.def:
προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Wis.19:4 * ;] 
to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: 2 Corinthiens 9:12 11:9.†

G4323.def:
προσ-ανα-τίθημι 
to lay on or offer besides; mid., 
__(a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides; 
__(b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: Galates 1:16 2:6 (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι)

G4324.def:
προσ-απειλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Sir.13:3 א * ;] 
to threaten further: Actes 4:21.†

G4325.def:
προσδαπανάω, -ῶ 
to spend besides: with accusative, Luc 10:35.†
SYN.: προσαναλίσκω

G4326.def:
προσ-δέομαι 
[in LXX: Proverbes 12:9 חָסֵר חָסֵר Sir.6:1-37 * ;] 
to want further, need in addition: Actes 17:25.†

G4327.def:
προσ-δέχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for רָצָה ;] 
__1. to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept: with accusative of person(s), Luc 15:2, Romains 16:2, Philippiens 2:29; with accusative of thing(s), Actes 24:15 (R, mg.), Hébreux 10:34 11:35. 
__2. to expect, look for, wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luc 12:36; with accusative of thing(s), Marc 15:43, Luc 2:25, 38 23:51, Actes 23:21, Tite 2:13, Ju 21 (cf. δέχομαι).†

G4328.def:
προσ-δοκάω, -ῶ
(the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω) [in LXX: Psaumes 104:27 (שָׂבַר pi.), etc. ;] 
to await, expect: Matthieu 24:50, Luc 3:15 12:46, Actes 27:33 28:6; with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 11:3, Luc 1:21 7:19-20 8:40 Actes 10:24; with accusative of thing(s), 2 Pierre 3:12-14; with accusative and inf., Actes 28:6; with inf., Actes 3:5.†

G4329.def:
προσδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(ιροσδοκάω), [in LXX: Genèse 49:10 (יִקָּהָה), Psaumes 119:116 (שֵׂבֶר) Wis.17:13, Sir.40:2, al. ;] 
expectation: with genitive obj., Luc 21:26; with genitive subjc., Actes 12:11.†

G4330.def: to suffer to go further , τινά (New Testament) (ML)

G4332.def:
προσεδρεύω
(πρόσεδρος, sitting near), [in LXX: 1Ma.11:40 * ;] 
__1. to sit near. 
__2. to attend regularly: with dative, 1 Corinthiens 9:13, Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).†
παρ-εδρεύω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 1:21 8:3 * ;] 
to sit constantly beside, attend constantly (cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, 1 Corinthiens 9:13.†

G4333.def:
προσ-εργάζομαι 
__1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.). 
__2. to gain besides, by working or trading: Luc 19:16 (Xen.).†

G4334.def:
προσ-έρχομαι 
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;] 
to approach, draw near: absol., Matthieu 4:11, Luc 9:42, al.; with infin., Matthieu 24:1, al.; with dative loc., Hébreux 12:18, 22; dative of person(s), Matthieu 5:1, and freq., Jean 12:21, al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., Matthieu 8:2, and freq., Marc 1:31, Luc 7:14, al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., Matthieu 4:3, Marc 6:35, 
Metaphorical, 
__(a) of approaching God: absol. (Lévitique 21:17, Deutéronome 21:5, al.), Hébreux 10:1, 22; τ. θεῷ, Hébreux 7:25 11:6; τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, Hébreux 4:16; πρὸς Χριστόν, 1 Pierre 2:4; 
__(b) in sense not found elsewhere (Field, Notes, 211), to consent to: ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, 1 Timothée 6:3

G4335.def:
προσ-ευχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσεύχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּפִלָּה ;] 
__1. prayer to God: Matthieu 17:21 (WH, R, txt., om.) Matthieu 21:22, Marc 9:29, Luc 22:45, Actes 3:1 6:4 10:31, Romains 12:12, 1 Corinthiens 7:5, Colossiens 4:2; pl., Actes 2:42 10:4, Romains 1:10, Éphésiens 1:16 Colossiens 4:12, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:2, Phm 4 22, 1 Pierre 3:7 4:7, Apocalypse 5:8 8:3-4; οἶκος προσευχῆς, Matthieu 21:13, Marc 11:17, Luc 19:46" (LXX) ; π. καὶ δέησις, Éphésiens 6:18, Philippiens 4:6; pl., 1 Timothée 2:1 5:5; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. Wis.16:28), Luc 6:12; πρὸς τ. θεόν, before ὑπέρ, Actes 12:5; pl., Romains 15:30; Hebraistically (B1., § 38, 3), προσευχῇ προσεύχεσθαι, Jacques 5:17 (EV, prayed fervently). 
__2. a place of prayer: of a synagogue (3Ma.7:20, seel.; see Charles, APOT, i, 173; for other exx., see Kennedy, Sources, 114); of a place in the open (FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 23), Actes 16:13, 16.†
SYN.: see: δέησις

G4336.def:
προσ-εύχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for פָּלַל hith. ;] 
to pray (always of prayer to God, or in cl., to gods): absol., Matthieu 6:5-7, 9 14:23 19:13 26:36, 39 26:41, 44, Marc 1:35 6:46 11:24-25 13:33 (WH, E, txt., om.) Marc 14:32, 38-39 Luc 1:10 3:21 5:16 6:12 9:18, 28-29 11:1-2 18:1, 10 22:44 (WH, E, mg., om.), Actes 1:24 6:6 9:11 10:9, 30 11:5 12:12 13:3 14:23 16:25 20:36 21:5 22:17 28:8, 1 Corinthiens 11:4-5 14:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:17, 1 Timothée 2:8, Jacques 5:13, 18; before λέγων, Matthieu 26:39, 42, Luc 22:41; with dative instr., 1 Corinthiens 11:5 14:14-15; μακρά, Matthieu 23:14 (WH, R, txt., om.), Marc 12:40, Luc 20:47; ἐν πνεύματι (ἁγίῳ), Éphésiens 6:18, Ju 20; προσευχῇ π. (a Hebraism, see: προσευχή), Jacques 5:17; with accusative of thing(s), Luc 18:11, Romains 8:26; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Jacques 5:14; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 6:6, 1 Corinthiens 11:13; before περί, with genitive, Actes 8:15, Colossiens 1:3 4:3, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:25, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:11 3:1, Hébreux 13:18; ὑπέρ, Matthieu 5:44 Luc 6:28, Colossiens 1:9, Jacques 5:16; before ἵνα, Matthieu 24:20, Marc 13:18 14:35, Luc 22:46, 1 Corinthiens 14:13; τοῦτο ἵνα, Philippiens 1:9; with inf., Luc 22:46; before τοῦ, with inf. (Bl., § 71, 3), Jacques 5:17.†

G4337.def:
προσ-έχω 
[in LXX for קָשַׁב hi., שָׁמַר ni., etc. ;] 
__1. to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.). 
__2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): Actes 8:6 16:14, Hébreux 2:1, 2 Pierre 1:19; in sense of caring or providing for, Actes 20:28; π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, Pr., 157; cf. Genèse 24:6, Exode 10:28, al.): Luc 17:3 21:34, Actes 5:35; id. before ἀπό (M, Pr., 102; B1., § 34, 11; 40, 3; see: βλέπω), Luc 12:1; (without dative) Matthieu 7:15 10:17 16:6, 11-12, Luc 20:46 (cf. Sir.6:13, al.); before μή, with inf. (M, Pr., 193; Bl., § 69, 4), Matthieu 6:1. 
__3. to attach or devote oneself to: with dative of person(s), Actes 8:10-11, 1 Timothée 4:1; with dative of thing(s), 1 Timothée 1:4 3:8 4:13 6:3 T (-ερχ-, WH, R), Tite 1:14, Hébreux 7:13.†

G4338.def:
προσ-ηλόω -ῶ 
[in LXX: 3Ma.4:9 * ;] 
to nail to: with accusative and dative, figuratively, Colossiens 2:14.†

G4339.def:
προσήλυτος, -ον
(προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר ;] 
__1. one who has arrived, a stranger. 
__2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): Matthieu 23:15, Actes 2:10 6:5 13:43.†

G4340.def:
πρόσ-καιρος, -ον 
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:2 4Mac 15:8 4Mac 15:23 * ;] 
__1. in season. 
__2. for a season, temporary, transient: 2 Corinthiens 4:18, Hébreux 11:25; of plants, short-lived: Matthieu 13:21, Marc 4:17.†

G4341.def:
προσ-καλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 10:1, Marc 3:13 6:7, Luc 7:19, Actes 5:40, Jacques 5:14, al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: Actes 2:39; with inf., Actes 16:10 (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, Actes 13:2.†

G4342.def:
προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ
(καρτερός, strong, stedfast) [in LXX: Nombres 13:21 (חָזַק hith.), Tob.5:8 א, Da Th Su 1:6* ;] 
to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), Marc 3:9, Actes 8:13 10:7; with dative of thing(s), Actes 1:14 2:42 6:4, Romains 12:12, Colossiens 4:2; before ἐν, Actes 2:46; εἰς, Romains 13:6.†

G4344.def:
προσ-κεφάλαιον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX: Eze.13:18, 20 (כֶּסֶת), I Esther 3:8 * ;] 
a pillow, cushion: Marc 4:38.†

G4345.def:
προσ-κληρόω, -ῶ 
to allot to, assign to by lot; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): Actes 17:4 (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).†

G4347.def:
προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;] 
to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, Josué 23:8, Sir.6:34 al.), before πρός, Marc 10:7 (R, txt.), Éphésiens 5:31 (LXX).†

G4348.def:
πρόσ-κομμα, -τος, τό
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Exode 23:33 34:12 (מוֹקֵשׁ), Ésaïe 8:14 (נֶגֶף), Jdth.8:22, Sir.17:25, al. ;] 
__(a) a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, Romains 9:32-33, 1 Pierre 2:8" (LXX) ; 
__(b) = προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, Romains 14:13, 20, 1 Corinthiens 8:9 (Plut.).†
SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.)

G4349.def:
προσκοπή, -ῆς, ή
(προσκόπτω), [in Gr. Ven.: Proverbes 16:18 (כִּשָּׁלוֹן) * ;] 
an occasion of stumbling, offence: 2 Corinthiens 6:3.†

G4350.def:
προσ-κόπτω 
[in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc. ;] 
__1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, Matthieu 4:6, Luc 4:11, (LXX) 
__2. Intrans., to stumble: absol. (Tob.11:9, Proverbes 3:23), Jean 11:9-10; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, Matthieu 7:27. Metaphorical, in late writers, 
__(a) to offend (Polyb.); 
__(b) to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, Romains 14:21; with dative, τ. λόγῳ, 1 Pierre 2:8; τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, Romains 9:32.†

G4351.def:
προσ-κυλίω 
to roll up, roll to: with accusative and dative, Matthieu 27:60; accusative before ἐπί, Marc 15:46.†

G4354.def:
προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Exode 4:16 AB2 (דָבַר pi.), Wis.13:17 * ;] 
to speak to: Actes 28:20; with dative of person(s), Actes 13:43.†

G4355.def:
προσ-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 18:16 (מָשָׁה hi.), Psaumes 73:24 (לָקַח), etc. ;] 
__1. to take in addition. 
__2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι; 
__(a) of things: of food, with accusative, Actes 27:33; with genitive part., Actes 27:36; 
__(b) of persons: with accusative, Matthieu 16:22, Marc 8:32 (see Swete, in l), Actes 17:5 18:26 28:2, Romains 14:1, 3 15:7, Phm 17.†

G4356.def:
πρόσ-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις, as in Att..), -εως, ἡ 
(προσλαμβάνω), 
__1. an assumption (Plat.). 
__2. a receiving (cf. προσλαμβάνω): Romains 11:15,†

G4357.def:
προσ-μένω 
[in LXX: Juges 3:25 A (חוּל hi.), Tob.2:2 א, Wis.3:9, 3Ma.7:17 * ;] 
__1. to wait longer, continue, remain still: Actes 18:18; before ἐν, 1 Timothée 1:3. 
__2. C. dative, to remain with: Matthieu 15:32, Marc 8:32. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, Actes 11:23 (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, Actes 13:43; τ. δεήσεσιν, 1 Timothée 5:5.†

G4358.def:
προσ-ορμίζω
(ὅρμος, an anchorage), 
to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): Marc 6:53.†

G4359.def: to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4360.def:
προσ-οχθίζω 
[in LXX: Lévitique 26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lévitique 18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psaumes 95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;] 
to be angry with: with dative, Hébreux 3:10 (LXX), Hébreux 3:17.†

G4362.def:
προσ-πήγνυμι 
to fasten to: absol., to crucify, Actes 2:23.†

G4363.def:
προσ-πίπτω
[in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;] 
__1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Matthieu 7:25. 
__2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Marc 7:25; with dative of person(s), Marc 3:11 5:33, Luc 8:28, Actes 16:29; τ. γόνασιν, Luc 5:8.†

G4364.def:
προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 21:13 (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), Job 19:14, (Sir 34:30 (Sir.31:30)), Dan LXX Su 1:11 * ;] 
to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: Luc 24:28.†

G4365.def:
προσ-πορεύομαι 
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;] 
to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), Marc 10:35.†

G4367.def:
προσ-τάσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] 
__1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to. 
__2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Luc 5:14; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 1:24; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 8:4, Marc 1:44; with accusative and inf., Actes 10:48; pass., Actes 10:33 17:26.†

G4368.def:
προστάτις, -ιδος, ἡ
(fem, of προοτάτης), 
a patroness, protectress: Romains 16:2.†

G4369.def:
προσ-τίθημι 
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;] 
__1. to put to. 
__2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, Matthieu 6:27, Luc 3:20 12:25; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, Actes 2:47; with accusative and dative, Luc 17:5, Hébreux 12:19 (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., Actes 2:41, Galates 3:19; with dative, Matthieu 6:33, Marc 4:24, Luc 12:31, Actes 5:14 11:24; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. Genèse 26:8, Juges 2:10, al.), Actes 13:36; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in Heb. idiom (Genèse 4:2 8:12, al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, Pr., 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi), Luc 20:11, Actes 12:3; similarly ptcp., προσ-θείς, with indic. (Genèse 38:5, al.), Luc 19:11.†

G4370.def:
προσ-τρέχω 
[in LXX for רוּץ ;] 
to run to: Marc 9:15 10:17, Actes 8:30.†

G4371.def:
προσφάγιον, -ου, τό
(φαγεῖν), 
Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον) 
a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), to be eaten with bread: Jean 21:5 (have ye taken any fish, Field, Notes, 109; Abbott, Essays, 105; cf. M, Pr., 170n; MM, Exp., xxi).†

G4372.def:
πρόσφατος, -ον
(on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως), [in LXX: Nombres 6:3 (לַח), Deutéronome 32:17, Ecclésiaste 1:9 (חָדָשׁ), Psaumes 81:9 (זוּר), Sir.9:10 * ;] 
__1. originally, freshly slain. 
__2. Generally (from Æsch. on), new, fresh, recent: ὁδός, Hébreux 10:20 (see MM, Exp., xxi; Rutherford, NPhr., 471 f.).†

G4373.def:
προσφάτως
adv. (see: πρόσφατος), [in LXX: Deutéronome 24:5 (חָדָשׁ), Jdth.4:3, 5, Eze.11:3, 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 14:16 ;] 
recently: Actes 18:2 (see MM, Exp., xxi).†

G4374.def:
προσ-φέρω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi. ;] 
__1. to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), Matthieu 4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16, Marc 2:4 (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) Marc 10:13, Luc 18:15 23:14; pass., Matthieu 12:22 (act., WH, txt.) Matthieu 18:24 (προσήχθη, WH) Matthieu 19:13; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 25:20; id. with dative of person(s), Matthieu 22:19, Luc 23:36; τ. στόματι, Jean 19:29; metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, Hébreux 12:7 (cl.). 
__2. to offer: Matthieu 2:11, Actes 8:18; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, Ant., iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, gifts and prayers to God: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), Marc 1:44, Luc 5:14, Hébreux 5:1, 3 9:7 10:12; pass., Actes 21:26; with accusative of thing(s) (δῶρον, θυσίαν, λυτρείαν, προσφοράν), Matthieu 5:23-24 (aoristic pres.; M, Pr., 247) Matthieu 8:4, Jean 16:2, Actes 7:42 21:26, Hébreux 5:1 8:3-4 9:7, 9 10:1-2, 8 10:11-12; δεήσεις τε κ. ἱκετηρίας, Hébreux 5:7; with accusative of person(s), Hébreux 11:17 (conative impf.; M, Pr., 129); of Christ, Hébreux 7:27 (ἀνενέγκας, WH, txt.) Hébreux 9:14, 25 9:28.†

G4375.def:
προσφιλής, -ές
(φιλέω), [in LXX: Esther 5:1, Sir.4:7 20:13 * ;] 
__(a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with); 
__(b) of things, pleas­ing, agreeable (EV, lovely): Philippiens 4:8.†

G4376.def:
προσ-φορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(προσφέρω), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:48 (פָּנִים) Psaumes 40:6 (מִנְחָה), I Esther 5:52, Sir.14:11, al. ;] 
__1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.). 
__2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: Actes 21:26 24:17, Éphésiens 5:2, Hébreux 10:5, 8 10:14; περί ἀμαρτίας, Hébreux 10:18; with genitive obj., Romains 15:16, Hébreux 10:10.†

G4377.def:
προσ-φωνέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 1Es.2:21 Esther 6:6 Esther 6:22, 2Ma.15:15 * ;] 
__1. to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): Actes 21:40 In late writers, with dative of person(s): Matthieu 11:16, Luc 7:32 13:12 23:20, Actes 22:2. 
__2. to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), Luc 6:13.†

G4378.def:
πρόσ-χυσις, -εως, ἡ 
a pouring or sprinkling upon: Hébreux 11:28.†

G4379.def:
προσ-ψαύω 
in poët. and late writers, 
to touch: with dative, Luc 11:46.†

G4380.def:
προσωπολημπτέω (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ 
(-λήμπτης, which see), 
to have respect of persons: Jacques 2:9.†

G4381.def:
προσωπο-λήμπτης (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ 
(πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον), 
a respecter of persons: Actes 10:34 (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 44).†

G4382.def:
προσωπολημψία (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ 
(προσωπολήμπτης) 
respect of persons: Romains 2:11, Éphésiens 6:9, Colossiens 3:25, Jacques 2:1 (see Mayor, in l).†

G4383.def:
πρόσωπον, -ου, τό
(πρός, ὤψ), [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים ;] 
__1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.); 
__(a) the face, countenance: Matthieu 6:16-17, Marc 14:65, Luc 9:29, 2 Corinthiens 3:7, Apocalypse 4:7, al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), Jacques 1:23; πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., Matthieu 17:6, Luc 5:12, Apocalypse 7:11, al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., Galates 1:22; π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17; κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, Actes 25:16, 2 Corinthiens 10:1 10:7, Galates 2:11; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, Pr., 99 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.), Luc 2:31, Actes 3:13; similarly ἀπὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים מִלִּפְּנֵי); see Dalman, Words, 29), from the presence of, Actes 3:19 5:41 7:45, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:9, Apocalypse 12:14 20:11; πρὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים לִפְנֵי), before, Matthieu 11:10, Marc 1:2, Luc 7:27" (LXX), al.; in other phrases resembling Heb. idiom (Thackeray, Gr., 42), βλέπειν (ὁρᾶν, θεωρεῖν, ἰδεῖν) τὸ π., to see one's face, i.e. see him in person, Matthieu 18:10, Actes 20:25, 38, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:10, Apocalypse 22:4; ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Hébreux 9:24; ἐν π. Χριστοῦ, 2 Corinthiens 2:10 4:6; μετὰ τοῦ π. σου with thy presence, Actes 2:28 (LXX); εἰς π. τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν, 2 Corinthiens 8:24; στηρίζειν τὸ π. (Heb. פָּנִים שׂוּם: Jérémie 21:10, al.; see Dalman, Words, 30), with inf., to set one's face towards, Luc 9:51; similarly, τὸ π. αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον (op. cit., 31), Luc 9:53; τὸ π. τοῦ κυρίου ἐπί, 1 Pierre 3:12 (LXX) 
__(b) form, person: καυχᾶσθαι. ἐν π. καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ, 2 Corinthiens 5:12 (cf. 1 Rois 16:7); metaphorically, as in Heb. idiom, of judgment according to appearance, external condition or circumstances (פָּנִים H5387; see Dalman, Words, 30; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.): λαμβάνειν π., Luc 20:21, Galates 2:6; βλέπειν εἰς π., Matthieu 22:16, Marc 12:14; θαυμάζειν πρόσωπα, Ju 16. 
__2. Of things (cf. Dalman, l.with) 
__(a) face, appearance (Psaumes 104:30): Matthieu 16:3 (WH, R, mg., om.), Luc 12:56, Jacques 1:11 
__(b) surface (Genèse 2:6): Luc 21:35, Actes 17:26

G4385.def:
προ-τείνω, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;]
to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), Actes 22:25.†

G4386.def:
before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time 
former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, formerly, Jn. 6:62

G4387.def:
A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον, 
[in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;] 
before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: Éphésiens 4:22. Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: Jean 7:50, 2 Corinthiens 1:15, Hébreux 4:6; opposite to ἔπειτα, Hébreux 7:27; τὸ π., Jean 6:62 9:8, Galates 4:13, 1 Timothée 1:13; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, Hébreux 10:32; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, 1 Pierre 1:14.†

G4388.def:
προ-τίθημι 
[in LXX: Exode 40:4, 23, Lévitique 24:8 (עָרַךְ) Psaumes 54:3 (שׂוּם), etc. ;] 
__1. to set before, set forth publicly; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), Romains 3:25 (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii). 
__2. Mid., to set before oneself, propose, purpose: with inf., Romains 1:13; with accusative of thing(s), Éphésiens 1:9.†

G4389.def:
προ-τρέπω 
[in LXX: Wis.14:18, 2Ma.11:7, 4Ma.12:7 4Mac 15:12 4Mac 16:13 * ;] 
to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): Actes 18:27.†

G4390.def:
προ-τρέχω 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 8:11 (פָּנִים רוּץ), Job 41:13 (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;] 
__1. to run forward. 
__2. to run on, run in advance: Jean 20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Luc 19:4.†

G4391.def:
προ-ϋπ-άρχω 
[in LXX: Job 42:18* ;] 
__1. to be beforehand in. 
__2. to be before or previously: with ptcp., Luc 23:12, Actes 8:9.†

G4392.def:
πρό-φασις, -εως, ἡ
(φήμι), [in LXX: Psaumes 141:4 (עֲלִילָה), ??עֲלִילָה), ??Daniel 6:4-5(5-6) (עִלָּה) Proverbes 18:1, Osée 10:4 * ;] 
a pretence, pretext: Matthieu 23:1 (WM, R, txt., om.), Marc 12:40, Luc 20:47 Jean 15:22, Actes 27:30, Philippiens 1:18, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:5.†

G4393.def:
προφέρω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 10:13 (מָצָא ni.), Tob.9:5, al. ;] 
to bring forth: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, Luc 6:45.†

G4394.def:
προφητεία, -ας, ἡ
(προψητεύω) [in LXX for נְבוּאָה, חָזוֹן ;] 
the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, prophecy, prophesying: of OT prophecy, Matthieu 13:14, 2 Pierre 1:20-21; of NT prophecy, Romains 12:6, 1 Corinthiens 12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22, 1 Timothée 4:14, Apocalypse 11:6 22:19; pl., 1 Corinthiens 13:8, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:20, 1 Timothée 1:18; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., Apocalypse 1:3 22:7, 10 22:18; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., Apocalypse 19:10 (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).†

G4395.def:
προφητεύω
(προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;] 
to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, Matthieu 7:22 26:68, Marc 14:65, Luc 1:67 22:64, Actes 19:6, 1 Corinthiens 11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39, Hébreux 11:3; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), Matthieu 11:13, Actes 2:17-18" (LXX) Actes 21:9; before περί, Matthieu 15:7, Marc 7:6, 1 Pierre 1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Apocalypse 10:11; λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, Jean 11:51.†
SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v

G4397.def:
προφητικός, -ά, -όν
(προφήτης), 
of prophecy, prophetic: Romains 16:26, 2 Pierre 1:19.†

G4398.def:
προφῆτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of προφήτης, 
[in LXX: Exode 15:20, Juges 4:4, 4Ki.22:14, 2 Chroniques 34:22, Ésaïe 8:3 (נְבִיאָה) * ;] 
a prophetess: Luc 2:36, Apocalypse 2:20.†

G4399.def:
προ-φθάνω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַם pi. ;] 
with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see), 
to anticipate: Matthieu 17:25.†
